answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a bonded stake and a per-epoch invariant that flags correlated registration bursts, treating every new node as ember that must burn collateral before joining the orchard of verified workers. A lantern-style challenge beacon randomly samples agents to prove unique liveness, and any duplicate attestation triggers. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
